releaseNotes:
v2.0.0 - first release of this fork for webOS TV 23+.
 - New namespace "dailous": install from this repository and switch existing devices to the new driver.
 - webOS 23+ pairing; pairing key in a masked preference.
 - Power-on detection by TCP probe instead of ICMP.
 - Security hardening: IPv4-only address, http(s)-only links, fewer TV permissions (pair again to apply).
See CHANGELOG.md for details.
author: Michael Dailous

drivers.description: Driver to control LG TV devices using webOS websockets.
